payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how the location of conferences can influence the diversity of participation in NLP research, particularly by encouraging local attendance and increasing the diversity index based on the countries of authors.

claims.text: Conferences held in different locations can increase local participation, thereby enhancing diversity in NLP research.
The diversity of participation is influenced by the location of conferences, as local events attract more regional researchers.
The relationship between conference location and diversity is significant, as it affects both attendance and the diversity index of participants.
